author: gogojedi
body: I was banned for using force field, or so the Mod thought.. I don't know why? The moment I was banned was because I was in a hole, and then I popped out and started hitting him and he couldn't, then bam I got banned? I don't use force field and hate people who do,  I have played on Avicus a long time and no one has ever reported me, but today something caused this and I don't know what? Could you please explain more then just banning me? Like give some proof? I am  sorry for being very angered, its just I don't like when something happens without a reason?

replies.body:
Hello gogojedi,

After some investigating, it seems that you have been ban evading ( https://avicus.net/_Capt#punishments ), therefore you will not be unbanned. However, if you do wish to have evidence for your original ban, you can view it here.

Regards,
